title: Ethereal Figure with Spirals
description: A translucent white silhouette of a young person stands centered, gazing upward with hands held before them, surrounded by glowing concentric spirals and dotted light patterns. The background features a soft grid structure with scattered holly-like foliage, sparkling particles, and delicate light beams in pastel hues.
prompt: A translucent glowing white silhouette of a young figure looking upward, hands gently raised, with luminous concentric dotted spirals emanating from their torso.
